concept:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a polished, review-ready 2D illustrated art direction board for the existing Memvoya side-scrolling tap-to-jump game Neon Run.
EDIT TARGET: Image 1 is an actual render of the existing runner engine using synthetic fixture positions. Transform its basic geometric visuals into the art direction below. This output is explicitly an ART CONCEPT, never claim it is a gameplay screenshot.
REFERENCES: Image 2 is the canonical existing chibi human adventurer side-view sprite sheet; preserve his dark shaggy hair, large head, brown layered explorer outfit, strapped small backpack/satchel, dark boots, compact body, proportions and recognizable silhouette, but use a clear running or jumping pose facing right. Image 3 is the existing canonical Echo companion side-view sprite sheet, a compact violet dragon-like chibi with blue-violet fins, two upward horns, luminous blue forehead marking and big eyes. Preserve Echo's identity and proportions; don't invent another companion or turn Echo into a fairy, cat or fox. Image 4 is the existing Spark-world backdrop, use only its warm golden light, faraway fantasy settlement and hanging bronze lantern vocabulary, simplified for a readable side-scroller. Image 5 is the canonical purple shard pickup; preserve its faceted purple-crystal identity.
ART DIRECTION: "Lanternway". A sun-warmed old stone causeway above a softly misted, cozy hill village. Apricot sky, honey-gold lantern light, desaturated teal mountains and rooftops receding in layers, mossy warm stone, a few bronze hanging lanterns high above the lane. Elegant, endearing, tactile polished 2D painted storybook game art. Rich detail in the environment edges but quiet, low-contrast negative space behind the action. Distinct from a violet moonlit garden: this is open-air golden late afternoon with warm cream, deep teal and terracotta, and crisp ink-dark silhouette edges. No neon grids or cyberpunk.
COMPOSITION: Landscape 3:2 concept board, approximately 1536x1024. Warm ivory border and professionally designed serif heading with restrained sans-serif annotations. Top title: "MEMVOYA / NEON RUN". Large heading: "Lanternway". Clear smaller subtitle, exactly: "2D art concept • not a gameplay screenshot".
Main left panel roughly 70% of the board is a SIDE-ON runner scene. Flat horizontal continuous stone walkway at about 75% of the scene height, a clean readable leading edge. Only one ground plane. Left-to-right movement. Adventurer at 20% horizontal position, in a compact hop facing right; Echo trails behind and slightly above. There are two distinct upright broken WAYSTONES ahead, solid dark teal-grey silhouette blocks with small amber fissures and chipped tops; different heights but each has a plainly rectangular solid body matching an obstacle box. No thin spikes, no floating damage blobs, no ground gaps, stairs, moving platforms, weapons or combat. One small purple shard floats at reachable hop height above an open stretch of the lane, and one blue shield charm is farther ahead. Maintain generous empty spacing; do not paint a trail of many pickups because the real game spawns individual pickups. Keep characters fully on-screen and danger immediately legible; soft character shadow for grounding. The hero can be enlarged somewhat for concept readability, but no cinematic close-up or false perspective.
Right column: three beautiful close-up vignettes on warm cream panels, clearly separated. 1. Adventurer and Echo together facing right, label "Familiar faces". 2. Two broken waystones, label "Jump the waystones". 3. Purple shard, label "Collect shards". Respect canonical likeness in both scene and close-up.
Bottom strip: six clearly distinct small illustrated collectible charms with clean dark edging, each with its exact label: "Shield" (blue shield pendant), "Magnet" (violet horseshoe magnet), "×2 Shards" (two gold-rimmed purple crystals), "Slow-Mo" (cyan hourglass), "Dash" (gold lightning charm), "Dream Surge" (rose star in a violet crystal). All are small polished illustrated physical charms, not plain geometric UI shapes. One text footer: "Tap to jump. Keep the trail clear."
CONSTRAINTS: This is one coherent 2D concept board for review only. Do not include fake scores, false live UI, phone frames, 3D engine screenshots or implementation claims. No new companion likeness, no changes to controls, no 3D action-adventure scope. No screenshot from another game. Keep labels crisp, not excessive. Present only one visual direction.
conceptRevision:

1. The jumpable WAYSTONE OBSTACLES in both the scene and the right-hand vignette must NOT have a lightning bolt or any engraved luminous emblem. Lightning is the beneficial Dash collectible, so putting it on hazards is misleading. Remove every bolt emblem from the four waystones. Keep the chipped solid dark slate stone columns with dull terracotta/copper broken seams and small ordinary moss details; danger reads from their solid dark block silhouette and jagged broken top, not a pickup-like glow. The far scenery immediately behind the runner and obstacles should be softer and lower contrast than the foreground, but still beautiful.
2. Correct Echo, the purple companion, in both the main scene and the "Familiar faces" vignette to the exact species/identity from reference Image 2, the canonical Echo sheet. Echo's blue-violet fan-like fins flare from the SIDES/BACK OF THE HEAD like broad cheek frills, NOT separate bat wings on the torso or shoulders. Preserve his two upright pointed horns, blue forehead diamond, big eyes, compact purple chibi body, short limbs and tail. Do not redesign him as a generic winged dragon. Show the familiar head-frill silhouette clearly. Keep the overall illustration polished and delightful.
Do not alter title/subtitle labels, especially "2D art concept • not a gameplay screenshot". No other changes.
